newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea tenders to buy 6,383T aluminium on Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea tenders to buy 6,383T aluminium on Dec 3.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) said on Wednesday it would invite tenders for 6,383 tonnes of aluminium by 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) next Tuesday.
An OSROK official said the aluminium must be high-grade primary ingots of London Metal Exchange-registered brand.
Delivery is set by February 28 to the OSROK's warehouses in Inchon (3,070 tonnes), Pusan (2,635 tonnes), Taegu (503 tonnes), and Kwangju (175 tonnes).
